values.name: Saputara
values.description: Saputara is a hill town in the Sahyadri range in southern Gujarat. Its lake, hill viewpoints and museum introduce visitors to the landscape and culture of the Dangs.
values.seasonal_note: Check weather and local access before visiting hill viewpoints. Museum reopening has not been confirmed.

records.notes: Tourism page title incorrectly says Don Hill Station, but body explicitly describes Saputara; independent government newsletter corroborates named attractions.

values.name: Saputara Lake
values.entry_fee: Free lakeside visit; optional boat rides charged separately
values.description: Saputara Lake has lakeside gardens and a boating facility in the centre of the hill town.
values.best_time_note: Coordinates identify the lakeside boating-house access point, not the centre of the water. Boat prices and operating hours are separate and not verified as a current tariff.
values.source: Gujarat Tourism; Gujarat Explorers; Google Maps

records.notes: Duration midpoint of published 1-2 hours. General free access is not free boat admission. Map snapshot pages/saputara-lake.json; boat-house rating not applied to whole lake. Physical accessibility unverified.

values.name: Sunset Point Saputara
values.entry_fee: Free viewpoint; optional ropeway, parking and activities extra
values.description: Sunset Point is a hill viewpoint overlooking the Sahyadri landscape near Saputara.
values.best_time_note: Visit around sunset. Road routing does not certify final pedestrian approach or wheelchair access; optional ropeway service is not included.
values.source: OpenStreetMap; Gujarat Explorers; My Holiday Happiness

records.notes: Published one-hour visit recommendation and free viewpoint fee; no invented fixed opening hours.

values.name: Saputara Museum
values.entry_fee: Current Indian adult admission and reopening unknown
values.description: The state museum documents the culture of the Dangs through clothing, jewellery, masks and other ethnographic objects.
values.best_time_note: Google Maps marks temporarily closed as checked September 30, 2026. The 2023 government directory lists 10:30-17:00, closed Wednesdays, second/fourth Saturdays and government holidays. Historical schedule is not stored as current hours. Confirm reopening directly before travel.
values.source: Ministry of Culture museum directory; Google Maps; MakeMyTrip

records.notes: Secondary Indian adult prices conflict (2,5,10). Official directory lists student1 and foreign50 but no Indian adult amount. Numeric price remains unknown, so existing planner excludes this attraction. One-hour duration from MakeMyTrip. Closure snapshot pages/saputara-museum.json.
